heading.zh-Hant: 早年、流亡與準軍事組織
heading.en: Early life, exile and the paramilitary movement

body.zh-Hant: 畢蘇斯基出身波蘭貴族家庭，生於當時屬俄羅斯帝國的歷史立陶宛地區。1887年他在一樁刺殺沙皇亞歷山大三世的陰謀中扮演有限且不自知的角色，被判流放西伯利亞五年。1893年加入波蘭社會黨；1900年被捕後佯裝瘋狂逃出俄國監獄，1902年定居奧屬加利西亞的克拉科夫。1904年日俄戰爭爆發後前往東京與日方交涉。1905年之後他組建波蘭準軍事力量，一戰時其步槍兵聯盟成為波蘭軍團的核心，1917年被德國人囚禁。
body.en: Piłsudski was born in historical Lithuania, then in the Russian Empire, to a Polish noble family. In 1887 he played a limited and unknowing part in a plot against Tsar Alexander III and was sentenced to five years of exile in Siberia. He joined the Polish Socialist Party in 1893, escaped a Russian prison in 1900 by feigning madness, and settled in Kraków in Austrian Galicia in 1902. In 1904, after the Russo-Japanese war began, he travelled to Tokyo to negotiate with the Japanese. After 1905 he built a Polish paramilitary; in the First World War his Union of Riflemen formed the core of the Polish legions, and in 1917 the Germans imprisoned him.

heading.en: Head of state and the Polish–Soviet war

body.zh-Hant: 協約國勝利為波蘭獨立開路後，畢蘇斯基出任國家元首兼總司令，在一系列戰爭中確定波蘭疆界，包括波蘇戰爭；1920年8月他指揮反攻，擊敗紅軍。他掌權到1922年，因認為總統權力過於有限而辭職。
body.en: After the Entente victory opened the way to Polish independence, Piłsudski became head of state and commander in chief and defined Poland's frontiers in a series of wars, among them the Polish–Bolshevik War. He led the counterattack that defeated the Red Army in August 1920. He held power through 1922, when he resigned after judging that the powers of the president were too limited.

body.zh-Hant: 畢蘇斯基1926年以軍事政變重返權力。他抱怨議員貪腐，卻沒有明確的議會民主替代方案；1928年成立「無黨派集團」以控制議會，1930年逮捕主要反對派政治人物。他出任過總理，之後滿足於戰爭部長與武裝部隊總監察長的職位，外交上在蘇聯與納粹德國之間走中間路線，與雙方簽署互不侵犯條約。他1935年去世，留下一部為他個人量身設計的威權憲法。
body.en: Piłsudski returned to power by military coup in 1926. He complained of the corruption of parliamentarians but had no clear alternative to parliamentary democracy. In 1928 he created a "non-party bloc" to control parliament, and in 1930 he arrested leading opposition politicians. He served as prime minister and then contented himself with the positions of minister of war and general inspector of the armed forces. In foreign affairs he steered a middle course between the Soviet Union and Nazi Germany, signing nonaggression pacts with each. He died in 1935, leaving behind an authoritarian constitution designed for him personally.

body.zh-Hant: 喬巴山出身貧困，先在喇嘛寺受教育，之後進入蒙古第一所中學。1919年他組織革命者小圈子，1920年與蘇赫巴托爾的圈子合併，成為蒙古人民黨。他此後參與確立1921年蒙古革命的各項軍事行動，並在1921年的黨第一次代表大會上當選中央委員，也成為臨時革命政府成員。
body.en: Choibalsan came from a poor background and was educated first in a lamasery and then in the first secondary school opened in Mongolia. In 1919 he formed a circle of revolutionaries, which merged in 1920 with Sükhebaatar's circle to become the Mongolian People's Party. From then on he took part in the military events that established the 1921 revolution, and in 1921 he was elected to the central committee at the party's first congress and joined the provisional revolutionary government.

body.zh-Hant: 1924年蒙古人民共和國宣告成立時，他在莫斯科軍事學院進修後成為人民軍總司令，1936年獲元帥頭銜。他1931至1935年任農牧經濟部長，1935至1939年任副總理，之後任黨第一書記並出任總理直到去世。來源稱他建立了與史達林相當的獨裁，並以「偏離路線」「通日本人」為由進行清洗。
body.en: In 1924, when the Mongolian People's Republic was proclaimed, he became commander in chief of the People's Army after a course at the Moscow military academy, and he received the title of marshal in 1936. He was Minister of Rural Economy from 1931 to 1935 and deputy prime minister from 1935 to 1939, then first secretary of the party and prime minister until his death. The source says he imposed a dictatorship comparable to Stalin's and carried out purges on grounds of "deviationism" and collusion with the Japanese.

body.zh-Hant: 范·赫茨1851年2月3日生於科弗登。1867年他入坎彭（Kampen）的教導營，1873年轉往荷屬東印度軍隊，並調往亞齊，1876年獲軍事威廉勳章。他在亞齊率精銳的 Marechaussee 部隊，以亞齊人自己的戰術對付他們，1897年以上校身分任巴達維亞總參謀長。
body.en: Van Heutsz was born at Coevorden on 3 February 1851. He joined the Instruction Battalion at Kampen in 1867 and in 1873 he volunteered for the Netherlands Indies army and was posted to Aceh, receiving the Military William Order in 1876. In Aceh he fought the Acehnese with their own tactics, leading the elite Marechaussee corps, and in 1897, as a colonel, he became chief of the general staff in Batavia.

body.zh-Hant: 1898年底起，范·赫茨擔任亞齊的文武總督，到1904年10月1日。這段期間他以快速突襲占領整片地區；1899年 Teukoe Oemar 在其中一次突襲中陣亡，1903年他制服了亞齊的僭稱蘇丹。
body.en: From December 1898 until 1 October 1904 Van Heutsz was civil and military governor of Aceh. In this period he occupied whole districts with swift surprise attacks; Teukoe Oemar fell during one such attack in 1899, and in 1903 he subdued the pretender sultan of Aceh.

body.zh-Hant: 范·赫茨1904年10月1日至1909年12月18日任荷屬東印度總督。他與科林（Colijn）合作推行行政縮減，並讓爪哇以外島嶼所有尚未獨立的印尼君主簽署「短聲明」，無條件服從荷蘭統治。加約與阿拉斯地區有整片地區人口消失，范·赫茨仍袒護范·達倫（Van Daalen）。
body.en: Van Heutsz was governor-general of the Netherlands Indies from 1 October 1904 to 18 December 1909. With Colijn he pushed through cuts in the administration, and by having them sign 'short declarations' he placed all the still independent Indonesian rulers on the islands outside Java unconditionally under Dutch authority. Whole districts in the Gayo and Alas lands were depopulated, and Van Heutsz continued to protect Van Daalen.

body.en: At the end of 1909 Van Heutsz stepped down as governor-general and settled in Amsterdam. After his wife's death in 1919 he withdrew from public life, from 1922 lived alternately in Montreux and Merano, and died at Montreux on 11 July 1924.

body.zh-Hant: 凱末爾1881年生於薩洛尼卡一個家境普通的家庭。1893年進入軍事中學，老師給他取了第二個名字「凱末爾」（完美）。1905年他以參謀上尉身分畢業，1906年被派往大馬士革的第五軍，1907年因職務前往馬其頓，在當地與青年土耳其黨人建立聯繫。
body.en: Mustafa Kemal was born in 1881 into a family of modest means in Salonica. In 1893 he entered a military secondary school, where his teacher gave him the second name Kemal ('perfection'). He graduated in 1905 as a staff captain, was assigned in 1906 to the Fifth Army in Damascus, and in 1907 was posted to Macedonia, where he made connections with the Young Turks.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰爭年代與安卡拉議會
heading.en: War years and the Ankara assembly

body.zh-Hant: 凱末爾參與1911至1912年抵禦義大利入侵的托布魯克與德爾納防衛，1915年在達達尼爾戰場嶄露頭角。1919年5月他前往安那托利亞展開民族抗爭，並在埃爾祖魯姆（7月23日）與錫瓦斯（9月4日）兩次會議上界定獨立的訴求。1920年4月23日他在安卡拉設立大國民議會，被一致選為首任議長，獨立戰爭期間任武裝部隊總司令。1922年10月11日穆達尼亞停戰協定確認勝利，議會11月1日廢除蘇丹制，但把哈里發留在奧斯曼家族。
body.en: Mustafa Kemal took part in the defence of Tripolitania at Tobruk and Derna against the Italian invasion of 1911–1912 and distinguished himself at the Dardanelles in 1915. In May 1919 he moved to Anatolia to begin the nationalist struggle, and at the congresses of Erzurum (23 July) and Sivas (4 September) he defined the nationalist demands. On 23 April 1920 he established the Great National Assembly in Ankara and was unanimously elected its first president; during the War of Independence he was commander in chief of the armed forces. The Armistice of Mudanya (11 October 1922) sealed the victory, and the assembly abolished the sultanate on 1 November 1922 while leaving the caliphate in the Ottoman House.

heading.zh-Hant: 共和國首任總統與改革
heading.en: First president of the Republic and reforms

body.zh-Hant: 1923年10月，第二屆大國民議會宣布共和，選凱末爾為首任總統。在他的主導下，1924年廢除哈里發的同年，宗教法部被撤銷並由司法部取代；1925年改用格里曆；1926年採用瑞士民法；1928年以拉丁字母取代阿拉伯字母；1934年通過姓氏法，議會贈他姓氏「阿塔圖克」（土耳其人之父），同年婦女獲得投票權。他1938年11月10日在伊斯坦堡去世。
body.en: In October 1923 the Second Grand National Assembly proclaimed the republic and elected Mustafa Kemal its first president. Under his guidance the assembly dismantled the Ministry of Seriat and replaced it with a Ministry of Justice in 1924, the year the caliphate was abolished; the Gregorian calendar replaced the Islamic one in 1925; the Swiss Civil Code was adopted in 1926; the Latin script replaced the Arabic in 1928; in 1934 a family-names law was passed, the National Assembly bestowed the surname Ataturk (Father of Turks) on him, and women received the vote. He died in Istanbul on 10 November 1938.

body.zh-Hant: 馬查多1871年9月28日生，出身寒微。他加入古巴第二次獨立戰爭（1895–1898）的起義軍，升到准將，戰後成為知名政治人物與商人，與美國資本家合作投資公用事業。1920年代初他取得自由黨的控制權，以「重生」為號召，1924年在相對公平的選舉中當選總統。
body.en: Machado was born on 28 September 1871 to humble origins. He joined the rebels of Cuba's second war of independence (1895–1898), rising to brigadier general, and afterwards became a prominent politician and businessman, investing in public utilities in association with American capitalists. By the early 1920s he had won control of the Liberal Party and, on a platform of national 'regeneration', was elected president in 1924 in a relatively fair election.

body.zh-Hant: 馬查多的第一個任期裡，他推動公共工程，包括完成中央公路與興建國家議會大廈，也試圖管制糖的生產，並在1927年提出關稅改革法案，保護新興的古巴產業。但他向美國銀行借了數筆貸款來支付工程，並傾向以武力處理罷工工人與學生。1928至1929年他仍受歡迎、牢牢掌握政局。
body.en: In his first term Machado embarked on a public works programme that included completing a central highway and building a national capitol, tried to regulate sugar production, and sponsored a tariff reform bill in 1927 to protect emerging Cuban industries. He nevertheless contracted several loans with U.S. banks to pay for the works and tended to use force against striking workers and restless students. In 1928–1929 he was still popular and had a grip on the political situation.

body.zh-Hant: 馬查多以賄賂與威脅把各反對黨納入影響之下，使國會與司法服從他，並推動修憲，在幾乎無人競爭下再度當選六年任期，1929年5月20日第二次就職。世界經濟大蕭條隨後波及古巴，1930年出現多起反政府示威，次年獨立戰爭老領袖在鄉間發動大規模軍事起事；他靠軍隊鎮壓，但1932年起鬥爭轉為政府鎮壓力量與ABC運動、學生指導委員會等地下組織之間的惡鬥。美國隨後派威爾斯出任駐哈瓦那大使；最終一場總罷工癱瘓全國。
body.en: Through bribes and threats Machado brought all the opposition parties under his influence and subordinated Congress and the judiciary to his will, then pushed through a constitutional change that let him be re-elected virtually unopposed for a new six-year term; his second inauguration was on 20 May 1929. The depression reached Cuba: in 1930 there were antigovernment demonstrations, and the next year veterans of the wars of independence staged a military uprising in the countryside. He crushed it with the army, but from 1932 the struggle degenerated into a vicious fight between government forces and clandestine groups such as the ABC movement and the Student Directorate. The United States then sent Sumner Welles as ambassador to Havana; in the end a general strike paralysed the nation.

body.zh-Hant: 1933年8月12日古巴軍方對總統採取行動，馬查多被迫搭機前往巴哈馬的拿騷，後來定居美國，六年後在邁阿密海灘去世。古巴歷屆政府此後都拒絕批准把他的遺骸運回故土。
body.en: On 12 August 1933 Cuba's armed forces moved against the president, and Machado was forced to take a plane to Nassau in the Bahamas. He eventually settled in the United States and died six years later in Miami Beach. Cuban governments since have refused to authorize the transfer of his remains to his native soil.
